title: Adansefo a Wɔayera no
intro: Wɔ bere bi a atwam mu no, na ɔmanfo bi te asase bi a ahemman ahorow ntam kwan so. Wɔn nkɔmhyɛni no frɛɛ wɔn kɔɔ nokware kwan no so, nanso wɔbataa gyidi a wonni ne nhyɛso ho. Saa asɛm yi ba awiei wɔ ɔsoro aweredi mu. So wubetumi afi nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛwɔ ase hɔ no mu ahu ɔman yi ne wɔn nkrabea?
clues: Nnipa bi pow kɔkɔbɔ a wɔn ankasa abɔfo no mu biako de bae no.
Ɔbɔfoɔ no frɛɛ yɛn sɛ yɛnsom Allah nko ara na ɔbɔɔ yɛn kɔkɔ wɔ porɔwee ho.
Na yɛn mmarato ne sɛ yɛbɛpo odiyifo a wɔsomaa yɛn baa yɛn mu no wɔ trenee mu.
Yegyee ɔbɔfo no tumidi ho kyim na yɛbɔɔ no sobo sɛ ɔdaadaa nkurɔfo.
Asotwe no baa yɛn so bere a na yɛte yɛn afie mu dwoodwoo no.
Wɔsɛee yɛn esiane sɛ yɛpoo yɛn diyifo no na yɛtaa agyidifo no nti.

arabic: وَإِلَىٰ مَدْيَنَ أَخَاهُمْ شُعَيْبًۭا فَقَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱرْجُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ
verse: And to Madyan [We sent] their brother Shuʿayb, and he said, "O my people, worship Allāh and expect the Last Day and do not commit abuse on the earth, spreading corruption." (29:36)
